choices.text: Meet with the workers to hear their concerns before you design anything.
Build a prototype quickly to show what is possible.
Propose a gradual rollout with cross-training for the people affected.

response.text: A packing house in Manteca wants to automate box labeling, a job four people do by hand now. Two have asked you directly whether they are being replaced, and the system is not proven yet.
response.title: Automating a manual job
